statusLine.command: input=$(cat); absdir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // ""'); case "$absdir" in "$HOME"*) dir="~${absdir#"$HOME"}";; *) dir="$absdir";; esac; branch=$(git -C "$absdir" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$branch" ] && git -C "$absdir" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch='-'; fi; model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "?"'); effort=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // ""'); ctx=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r 'if .context_window.used_percentage != null then .context_window.used_percentage elif ((.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0) > 0 and (.context_window.context_window_size // 0) > 0) then (.context_window.total_input_tokens / .context_window.context_window_size * 100) else empty end'); h5=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // 0'); d7=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // 0'); out="$dir"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out | $branch"; out="$out | $model"; [ -n "$effort" ] && out="$out | $effort"; [ -n "$ctx" ] && out="$out | $(printf '%.0f' "$ctx")% context"; out="$out | $(printf '%.0f' "$h5")% $(printf '%.0f' "$d7")% 5h 7d"; printf '%s' "$out"
